items.name: GLS Gdynia 2020
items.information:
This is final competition of GLS Cup 2019 series. During winners ceremony we will reward 5 top speedcubers from various [GLS classifications](https://www.speedcubing.pl/gdanska-liga-2019/klasyfikacje-ligowe).
GLS Cup 2019 is a series of 5 official WCA competitions in Gdańsk and Gdynia. GLS is combining 5 competitions into one ranking system including:
- General classification of all events
- 3x3x3 classification for kids,
- 3x3x3 for parents 
- 3x3x3 Fewest Moves League
At the main venue we have big rollup banner with the names of [GLS Record](https://www.speedcubing.pl/gdanska-liga-2019/rekordy-gls) holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. After the first day we host cubers integration. Next to the hotel we have parking area and shops.
If you want to join us, you are most welcome!

items.name: Swisscubing Cup I 2020
items.information:
SC Cup I is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2020, made of 6 competitions during the whole year. Check out on https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/?lang=en for the details of the other editions.
A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Der SC Cup I ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2020. Dieser besteht aus 6 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/.
Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Le SC Cup I fait partie du Swisscubing Cup 2020, qui consiste de 6 compétitions tout au long de l'année. Allez voir sur https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/?lang=fr pour plus d'informations sur les autres autres manches.
Un compétiteur qui s'inscrit et ne vient pas à la compétition (sans nous l'annoncer à l'avance) devra payer des frais d'inscription supplémentaires à sa prochaine compétition en Suisse.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

SC Cup I da parte della Swisscubing Cup 2020, che è composta da 6 competizioni tenute durante l'anno. Qui (https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2020/?lang=it) trovi le informazioni relative alle altre edizioni. Un partecipante che si iscrive a una competizione ma non si presenta deve pagare la tassa di iscrizione alla sua prossima competizione in Svizzera.

-Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us.
